messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: shared-gpu-pool latency SLO breach detected
incident-bot: metric=latency_p99, value=2.82s, threshold=1.5s; streaming_stalls spike +320% in last 10m; affected pool=shared-gpu-pool; dashboard=https://dash.redwood/alerts/2380012345 :rotating_light:

Maya (oncall): acked, I'm on it. tagging eng-sre and runtime. anyone already looking?

Kai (eng-sre): I'm on. pulling pod list for shared-gpu-pool..
Kai (eng-sre): `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=shared-gpu -o wide` shows pod gpu-tn-17 at 98% mem, node gnode-45. scheduling looks normal.

Samir (runtime): running `nvidia-smi` on gnode-45 now, one process hogging SM and mem:
```
# nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory,gpu_util --format=csv
12345,python,15386MiB,98 %
```
Samir (runtime): container id corresponds to tenant t-4242 (real-time streaming customer).

Luca (support): Support flagged multiple customer threads: acme-payments reported repeated stalls at ~15:42 UTC, flowchat has jittered streams, canvas.ai elevated ticket. customers impacted ~3 in last 30m.

Priya (product): how widespread? is this all of shared-gpu or single tenant? need quick ETA to tell customers.

Maya (oncall): looks like noisy-tenant. priority = isolate tenant and restore p99. Kai, can we throttle IO / cgroup for that container?

Kai (eng-sre): Checking cgroups and blkio on the node. `cat /proc/12345/cgroup` -> blkio path at `/sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/docker/abcd...`
Kai (eng-sre): blkio stats show high writes to /dev/nvme0n1. `iostat -x` shows sda utilization 98% and high await.

Samir (runtime): also seeing heavy GPU memcpy on that process, combined GPU + IO heavy workload. This is multi-tenant interference: the tenant is saturating IO and GPU kernel time.

Maya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) move tenant t-4242 off shared-gpu pool to isolation node 2) enable routing fallback for streaming requests to smaller model variant for affected customers 3) add short-term cgroup weight cap if move fails. executing step 1 now.

Kai (eng-sre): cordoning gnode-45 and evicting offending pod to force reschedule to dedciated node iso-15 (has spare).
Kai (eng-sre): `kubectl cordon gnode-45 && kubectl delete pod gpu-tn-17 -n inference --grace-period=30`
Kai (eng-sre): evict initiated. watching pods...

incident-bot: Runbook note: if noisy tenant moves fail, escalate to infra for node-level IO throttle.

Samir (runtime): also flipped routing for acme-payments to model-variant-compact via feature-flag, should reduce tokenization + GPU load.

Luca (support): updated acme-payments and flowchat with 'we're mitigating and expect full restoration within 10-15m' :thumbsup:

Kai (eng-sre): pod rescheduled to iso-15 at 15:50 UTC, `kubectl get pods` shows t-4242 now on iso-15; initial p99 has dropped on dashboard.

Priya (product): any downstream errors from callers? logs?

Samir (runtime): logs show a few `stream stalled` events during the window, customer-level retries caught most. error rate delta +0.4% during peak.

Maya (oncall): monitoring p95/p99 now. 
Maya (oncall): p99 back to 0.28s in 6m after move, p95 stable. streaming stalls back to baseline. marking incident as mitigated, but not closed yet.

Kai (eng-sre): quick root-cause notes: tenant t-4242 executed a heavy batched GPU memcpy + disk IO workload that exceeded multi-tenant fairness thresholds and caused tail latency on shared nodes. cgroup blkio weight wasn't limiting NVMe bursts.

Samir (runtime): short-term action items: enforce per-tenant GPU time slicing threshold (already on roadmap), add blkio weights for containers on shared-gpu pool (apply default of 500), and detect >80% GPU SM for >5m -> auto-isolate.

Priya (product): need comms plan for customers. Luca can you craft post-update that we throttled and isolated their tenant, apologised, and offer to discuss dedicated capacity?

Luca (support): drafting now, will post in customer threads and paste here for review.

Maya (oncall): I'll hand off to oncall-day for full postmortem tomorrow. tagging @day-oncall. please triage any follow-ups.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 2380012678 (p99 0.28s). Actions recorded to incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/2380012345/actions

Kai (eng-sre): +1 on postmortem. propose automated alert: p99 > 1.5s & share-gpu pool nodes with blkio utilization > 90% -> page infra and runtime teams.

Samir (runtime): also recommend adding `nvidia-smi dmon` watch to detect runaway memcpy loops.

Priya (product): add to next weekly cadence: dedicated capacity upsell for noisy tenants and clear SLA language.

Maya (oncall): thanks team. I'll close after postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:
